title: Darline Graham Is ‘a Little Nervous.’ Can She Keep South Carolina’s Senate Seat Red?
summary: Polls show the sister of the late Senator Lindsey Graham in a virtual tie with her Democratic opponent, Dr. Annie Andrews. An upset was unthinkable just a few months ago.
